historical_references.reference: Jayanand was a renowned Sanskrit scholar and poet from the 13th century in South India. He is best known for his work 'Jayamangalasutra', a Sanskrit encyclopedia of all aspects of life including literature, art, music, and sciences.

Jayanand was also a Jain scholar who composed various commentaries on Jain texts, including the 'Bhagavati-sutra' and 'Tattvartha-sutra'. He played a significant role in the preservation and propagation of Jainism during the medieval period in India.
